title: Late-Review Goodwill Computation — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
**Scope of the computation.** The goodwill is worked for the account's most recently decided approved recovery request whenever Trust and Safety decided it more than 7 calendar days after it was submitted; a request decided within that time is outside the schedule. Because the published review time is the tier's recovery review time in business days and no span of that many business days, weekends and US federal holidays included, reaches 7 calendar days, a request decided later than that has always missed it.

**Computation.**

- The days the recovery review took are the calendar days from the request's submission date to its decision date.
- The days the review was late are the days the recovery review took less 7.
- The late-review goodwill figure is $2.00 for each day the review was late.
- For a grant under this schedule the yearly goodwill total is the sum of the goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today, a grant may not exceed the tier's per-case goodwill limit nor bring that yearly goodwill total above the tier's yearly goodwill limit, and a grant beyond either limit is made only up to the remaining limit; a goodwill grant made under none of Harborline's published service-failure goodwill schedules (late hosting provisioning, late recovery review decisions, same-day duplicate domain auto-renew charges, late certificate issuance, late recovery resets and late refund postings) remains under the base limit sentence.
- The late-review goodwill granted is the late-review goodwill figure limited in that way and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; where the limited amount is zero, nothing is owed under this schedule and no entry is posted.
- In working the figure through to the amount granted, the figure is first multiplied by the multiplier that applies, the fixed uplifts that apply are then added, the limits are then applied, and only the final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

The per-case and yearly limits are those of the account's tier in the goodwill limits by tier.

**Example (hypothetical).** A request submitted on 4 May and approved on 15 May took 11 calendar days; it was 4 days late, giving a figure of $8.00. On a Harborline Business Account with $76.50 of goodwill entries dated after the same calendar date one year before today, the yearly room is $80.00 less $76.50, $3.50, so $3.50 is granted.

**Boundary.** Submitted 4 May and decided 11 May: 7 days, not more than 7, so outside the schedule. Decided 12 May: 8 days, 1 day late.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts*
